commands.label: usb-backup
commands.note: Back up D: files to C:\Temp\ before wiping. No UAC needed.
commands.command: powershell -WindowStyle Hidden -Command "New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force 'C:\Temp\usb_backup' | Out-Null; Copy-Item 'D:\alpine-standard-3.24.3-x86_64.iso' 'C:\Temp\usb_backup\' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Copy-Item 'D:\claude_boot' 'C:\Temp\usb_backup\claude_boot' -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Copy-Item 'D:\ventoy' 'C:\Temp\usb_backup\ventoy' -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; $r=@{cmd='cmd-019';label='usb-backup';status='done';ts=(Get-Date -Format 'yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ');files=(Get-ChildItem 'C:\Temp\usb_backup' -Recurse | Select-Object -Expand FullName)};$j=Get-Content 'C:\Users\endos\AppData\Roaming\npm\node_modules\@anthropic-ai\claude-code\..\..\..\relay\from_cli.json' -Raw -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ConvertFrom-Json -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue;if(-not $j){$j=@{results=@();updated=''}};$j.results+=$r;$j.updated=(Get-Date -Format 'yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ');$j|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10|Set-Content 'relay\from_cli.json'"

commands.label: ventoy-fresh-install
commands.note: Fresh Ventoy install on D: (PNY 128GB). WIPES D:. UAC dialog will appear - click Yes. Looks for Ventoy2Disk.exe in common locations.
commands.command: powershell -WindowStyle Hidden -Command "$paths=@('C:\Ventoy\Ventoy2Disk.exe','C:\Users\endos\Downloads\Ventoy2Disk.exe','C:\Temp\Ventoy2Disk.exe','C:\Temp\usb_backup\ventoy\Ventoy2Disk.exe',(Get-ChildItem 'C:\Users\endos\Desktop' -Filter 'Ventoy2Disk.exe' -Recurse -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1 -Expand FullName));$exe=$paths|Where-Object{Test-Path $_}|Select-Object -First 1;if($exe){Start-Process $exe -ArgumentList '/I D:' -Verb RunAs -Wait}else{[System.IO.File]::WriteAllText('C:\Temp\ventoy_not_found.txt','Ventoy2Disk.exe not found. Please place it in C:\Temp\ and re-run.')}"

commands.label: usb-restore
commands.note: Restore alpine ISO and claude_boot back to D: after fresh Ventoy install. No UAC needed. Run after cmd-020 completes.
commands.command: powershell -WindowStyle Hidden -Command "Copy-Item 'C:\Temp\usb_backup\alpine-standard-3.24.3-x86_64.iso' 'D:\' -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Copy-Item 'C:\Temp\usb_backup\claude_boot' 'D:\claude_boot' -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; $r=@{cmd='cmd-021';label='usb-restore';status='done';ts=(Get-Date -Format 'yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ');d_files=(Get-ChildItem 'D:\' | Select-Object -Expand Name)};$j=Get-Content 'relay\from_cli.json' -Raw -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ConvertFrom-Json -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue;if(-not $j){$j=@{results=@();updated=''}};$j.results+=$r;$j.updated=(Get-Date -Format 'yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ');$j|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10|Set-Content 'relay\from_cli.json'"

commands.label: watchdog-reg
commands.note: Register Cloud_DC_Watchdog scheduled task (auto-restart DC Clone, poller, DC Remote every 15 min).

commands.label: defender-excl
commands.note: Add Defender exclusions for Signal/relay folders to prevent scan interference.
